evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~8 to 30.8 ppm after being stable ~7 ppm through ramp
Tube pressure creeping up 3.04 -> 3.27 Torr at constant Ar flow
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure rise is not from flow change
Temperature control at 750 °C nominal, heater power steady

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, and a leak-check (e.g., brief Ar flow step or pump-down isolation test) to distinguish air ingress through a seal from exhaust restriction or O2 sensor drift
